criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use an oblique isometric projection with visible roofs and façades.
Diagonal roads and ground axes recede at closely matched angles.
different: The candidate reads slightly steeper and more top-down.
The candidate exposes a more explicit orthogonal ground grid, while the reference framing is more pictorial.

evidence.observation: Dense roofs, façades, and crossing diagonal roads establish the reference isometric camera.
Roofs and façades follow nearly the same oblique projection and diagonal recession.
Roads and structures have a moderately pitched cinematic framing.
